content.user_title: Review Release Impact Before You Ship
content.value_statement: Release changes can miss affected packages, generated templates, tests, or required adopter actions. This skill structures a focused review of release impact, changelog updates, classification, and human approval gates.
actual_capabilities: Reviews feature or release changes against the relevant branch or version tag.
Identifies payload paths and checks their release classification.
Reviews generator, template include or exclude, and documentation snapshot impact.
Drafts user-facing changelog bullets and required adopter actions.
Links tests, classification, scaffold acceptance, and human release gates.
limitations: It provides advisory analysis and does not merge pull requests or publish releases.
It does not bump versions or use publishing credentials.
It requires repository release documentation and available diffs for reliable conclusions.
It cannot replace a human approval gate for a release.

use_cases.title: Prepare a feature pull request
use_cases.description: Check changed payload paths, release labels, tests, and changelog needs before requesting review.

use_cases.title: Audit a release pull request
use_cases.description: Compare the release against the previous version tag and identify generated-tree, template, and adopter impacts.

use_cases.title: Validate a generator change
use_cases.description: Review include and exclude rules, documentation snapshots, scaffold acceptance, and the required human gate.

prompt_templates.title: Check a feature pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature pull request against main. Identify changed payload paths, release classification, tests, and changelog actions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft release notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current changes and draft concise user-facing changelog bullets plus required adopter actions. Cite relevant tests.

prompt_templates.title: Audit generated output
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze generator and template changes. Check include and exclude rules, documentation snapshots, generated trees, and scaffold acceptance.

prompt_templates.title: Assess release readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a release-readiness review against the previous v tag. Report classification, tests, generated output, adopter actions, and any missing human gate. Stop when a gate is absent.

output_examples.input: Review a pull request that changes the package generator and its templates.
output: Checks: verify template exclusions, generated tree contents, documentation snapshots, and scaffold acceptance.
Adopter action: regenerate affected projects and review the generated diff.

output_examples.input: Review a feature pull request that changes application code and tests.
output_examples.output: Suggested title: feat: update application workflow. Release notes should mention the user-visible behavior, linked tests, and any required upgrade step.

best_practices: Read repository release documentation before assessing impact.
Compare against the correct branch or previous version tag.
Treat the repository changelog and human approval gate as authoritative.
anti_patterns: Do not merge a release pull request from the advisory output alone.
Do not claim generated output is safe without checking include and exclude rules.
Do not omit adopter actions, tests, or scaffold acceptance from the review.

faq.question: Does this skill publish releases?
faq.answer: No. It provides advisory review and does not merge releases or use publish credentials.

faq.question: What comparison does it use?
faq.answer: It compares feature changes with main or release changes with the previous v tag.

faq.question: Can it write a changelog?
faq.answer: It drafts user-facing changelog bullets while keeping the repository release changelog authoritative.

faq.question: Does it review generated output?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks generator impact, template include or exclude rules, documentation snapshots, and generated trees.

faq.question: What happens when a human gate is missing?
faq.answer: The review stops and reports that the release requires the missing human approval.

faq.question: Who benefits from this skill?
faq.answer: Developers, release managers, and platform engineers who need a structured release-impact review.
